comment: The wasm-lua runtime RNG's contracts run on under wasm-patch@1.0 (paralith-mono release/wasm-lua-next 059fa875: rng@1.0 for ao.resolve over the node's wp_rng_* natives, hyperbeam feat/wasm-patch-rng; and the C JSON encoder, which RNG's vendored jsonenc.lua does not opt into). The bytes come from PARALITH_MONO's backend/native/wasm-lua/<file>, or WASM_LUA_RUNTIME; deploy.mjs refuses any other hash.
